discovery.Chain

Class to get data from chain.

Available as lseg.data.discovery.Chain.

Syntax

Chain(name)

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
name Yes chain name

Properties

Property Description
constituents Constituents of the chain.
name Chain name.
summary_links Summary links of the chain.

Example

chain = Chain("0#.DJI")
print(list(chain))
print(chain.constituents)
print(chain.summary_links)
